title: Ring Size Converter
description: Convert ring sizes between US, UK, EU and Japanese systems from inner circumference or diameter.
howto: Fill in any one measurement: inner circumference (mm), inner diameter (mm) or US size.
Read the matching US, UK, EU/ISO and Japanese sizes instantly.
Measure circumference with a strip of paper around the finger for best accuracy.

faqs.q: How accurate is the US size formula?
faqs.a: US size ≈ (circumference in mm − 36.9) ÷ 2.5, which matches standard charts within a quarter size. Brands vary slightly, so treat it as a guide.

faqs.q: What is EU / ISO ring size?
faqs.a: The ISO standard: ring size equals the inner circumference in millimeters (e.g. 52 = 52 mm around).

faqs.q: Should I measure in the morning or evening?
faqs.a: Measure at the end of the day when fingers are largest, and measure 3-4 times for consistency.
